question: Does the compact full-MLP representation that passed both finite capacity and infinitesimal projected-Muon direction gates preserve the matched QK-only dense-MLP parent's 124M/0.5TPP loss?

theory.slow_state_role: two additive pair-VQ stages on c_fc and one on c_proj supply the finite endpoint/function class
theory.fast_state_role: one freely recoded Cartesian pair lattice on c_fc resolves small optimizer displacements without a dense residual buffer
theory.capacity_inheritance: zero fast levels make the new class a strict representational superset of the fixed-checkpoint capacity-qualified slow representation
theory.attention_control: only QK is mapped; V and attention output projection remain dense so this experiment isolates the MLP replacement

accounting.optimizer_extra_work: slow pair-VQ projection plus one global c_fc fast-residual recode per optimizer step

decision_policy: Run the matched parent first, then the compact candidate. A candidate failure triggers analysis of the loss curve and projected-direction trajectory; it does not authorize a parameter or learning-rate sweep.
